title: Establish the rotation
screen_action: Open the workspace. Show DXB-FRA-DXB and the 11:00 next departure. Explain that the airline and incident are fictional.
expected_or_presenter: "We are preparing the ground response, not controlling this aircraft."

title: Receive an airborne event
screen_action: As SIMULATOR, load nominal. Show the event timestamp, destination, source and reported symptom.
expected_or_presenter: Case CREATED. The physical fault has not been diagnosed by the model.

title: Apply the authority boundary
screen_action: Inspect the supplied authorization: ENABLED, GROUND_PREPARATION_ONLY, expires 07:00Z.
expected_or_presenter: "Maintenance Control permits preparation. Flight safety stays outside this workspace."

title: Assemble relevant evidence
screen_action: Select MCC and run Prepare recovery plan. Reference mode is visibly marked; live mode performs the configured local model calls.
expected_or_presenter: History includes HIST-0042. Retrieve applicable current documents; exclude wrong type, configuration, tenant, future and untrusted content.

title: Check the ground resources
screen_action: Show FRA physical stock 1 but usable stock 0; AMS usable 1; eligible FRA engineer and tool; expired and wrong-type alternatives.
expected_or_presenter: "A database count is not the same as an available, usable component or an authorized person."

title: Compare options
screen_action: Show A: conditional local resolution. B: dispatch-review evidence only. C: component movement contingency. D: no uncommitted compatible spare.
expected_or_presenter: A meets the illustrative schedule if its physical assumptions hold. C does not: AMS part ready at FRA 12:20 CEST. B is never a flight permission.

title: Approve preparation
screen_action: As MCC, click Approve preparation before the plan expires.
expected_or_presenter: One approval, one reversible component hold, and three simulated outbox records. No real notification, shipment or work-order integration occurs.

title: Aircraft remains airborne
screen_action: Switch to SIMULATOR; advance to 08:30 CEST. Show AIRBORNE, 20 minutes to stand, prepared evidence and held contingency.
expected_or_presenter: "The aircraft has not arrived, but the ground team has its preparation package."

title: Arrive and validate physically
screen_action: As SIMULATOR, click Arrive at stand: 08:50 CEST.
expected_or_presenter: State ON_STAND. Authorized personnel perform physical work outside this application. No actual procedure is generated here.

title: Record the external outcome
screen_action: As SIMULATOR, record external completion at 09:35 CEST; export evidence JSON.
expected_or_presenter: State CLOSED; unused hold released. Status came from an external-system fixture, not from the model.
